hooks.command: codex_home="${CODEX_HOME:-$HOME/.codex}"; printf '%s\n' '[codex-alpha-goal-compact-recovery:v1] Compact recovery policy:' 'After compaction, before the next substantive action, decide whether one or more candidate skills below applies to the current task.' 'If a candidate applies, read its SKILL.md completely from the path below before acting; treat pre-compaction remembered skill text as stale.' 'If none applies, continue normally without loading these skills.' 'Candidate skills:' "- \$alpha-goal: use for requirements, goal framing, design, scope, acceptance evidence, decision boundaries, and claim boundaries. Path: $codex_home/skills/alpha-goal/SKILL.md" "- \$control-loop: use for bounded implementation or hardening after an explicit goal specification. Path: $codex_home/skills/control-loop/SKILL.md" "- \$evidence-verify: use for judging fresh evidence against an explicit Goal Contract or claim boundary. Path: $codex_home/skills/evidence-verify/SKILL.md"
hooks.statusMessage: Refreshing Alpha Goal compact recovery policy
